name: Molecule
definition: A chemical entity identified by molecule_id. It is the unit at which a toxicity label is recorded and the whole to which atoms and bonds belong.
scope: Structural, compositional and label-level analysis of the toxicology database.

name: Atom
definition: An individual atom belonging to a molecule, identified by atom_id and characterised by exactly one element value. Every atom_id starts with the molecule_id of its owning molecule followed by an underscore.
scope: Atomic composition and local bonding analysis within molecules.

name: Chemical Element
definition: The element type of an atom, stored directly as a lowercase element symbol in atom.element. 21 distinct values are observed: h, c, o, n, cl, s, br, na, p, f, i, si, sn, cu, zn, y, te, pb, k, ca, b.
scope: Element-level composition, filtering and grouping of atoms.

name: Bond
definition: A chemical bond between two atoms of the same molecule, identified by bond_id and carrying exactly one bond_type. Every bond_id starts with the molecule_id of its owning molecule followed by an underscore.

name: Bond Type
definition: The bond order recorded in bond.bond_type. Observed values are single '-', double '=' and triple '#', plus one row whose bond_type is NULL.
scope: Filtering and grouping bonds by bond order.

name: Toxicity Label
definition: The binary label recorded per molecule in molecule.label. The only observed values are '+' (152 molecules) and '-' (191 molecules). The database itself contains no data dictionary stating which polarity denotes an active, toxic or carcinogenic outcome.
scope: Binary classification of molecules; available only for molecules that have a row in the molecule table.

name: Atomic Adjacency
definition: A directed record stating that two atoms of the same molecule are directly bonded. Because the relation is stored in both directions, the table holds 24758 rows for 12379 distinct bonds.
scope: Neighbour, degree and connectivity analysis over the molecular graph.

name: Molecular Size
definition: The number of atoms belonging to one molecule, obtained by counting atom records per molecule_id. Observed range is 4 to 174 atoms with a mean of about 27.8 across 444 molecules.
scope: Comparing molecule complexity; defined for every molecule that has atom records.

name: Bond Count
definition: The number of bonds belonging to one molecule, obtained by counting bond records per molecule_id. Observed range is 2 to 175 with a mean of about 27.9 across 444 molecules.
scope: Comparing molecule connectivity; defined for every molecule that has bond records.

name: Atom Degree
definition: The number of directly bonded neighbours of one atom, obtained by counting the distinct neighbours recorded for that atom in the atomic adjacency records. Observed values are 1, 2, 3 and 4.
scope: Local bonding environment of an atom; atoms without adjacency records have no degree value in this data.
